headline: French postal unit hack exposes 22M people; TSMC breach tied to cloud provider; Check Point and UnrealIRCd KEV deadlines hit 11-16

bullets.text: New: a hack at a French postal unit exposed the data of 22 million people (DataBreaches.net).
New: TSMC's employee data breach is linked to a cloud service provider (BleepingComputer). TSMC is now a developing situation across 4 outlets.

KEV deadlines arrive tomorrow, 11-16: Check Point CVE-2026-123039 (PHP2Shell, 4 outlets), where attackers gain root on gateways, plant a backdoor and deploy a VMware ESXi wiper; and UnrealIRCd CVE-2026-114713 (server-level command injection).
Still active: Cursor says a stolen Fireworks AI key led to the trojanized Claude Code extension incident; Uber separately reports driver licenses stolen via Fireworks AI.
SCKit (3 outlets): worm-like malware aimed at MSPs that abuses ScreenConnect to deploy remote access and target technician sessions. Microsoft has published details.

Apache httpd CVE-2026-119618 remains open. KEV due 11-24: Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320, Openwave CVE-2026-111793, Outlook CVE-2026-124194, Chromium CVE-2026-125350. Last 7 days run 1.16x the 90-day average.

actions: Check Point: apply the vendor fix for CVE-2026-123039 before 11-16, restrict management access, hunt for backdoors, keep ESXi backups offline.
UnrealIRCd: patch or take internet-facing servers offline for CVE-2026-114713 before 11-16, and check them for injected commands.
Review which cloud providers hold employee data, and confirm their access logging and breach-notification terms in light of the TSMC incident.
Cursor and Claude Code users: review installed extensions against Cursor's disclosure and rotate any Fireworks AI API keys.
ScreenConnect: inventory instances and extensions, review technician sessions and hunt for SCKit using Microsoft's guidance.
Patch Apache httpd for CVE-2026-119618 and queue BroadWorks, Openwave, Outlook and Chromium before the 11-24 KEV due date.
